first.rationale: Targeted promotional pricing most directly addresses the immediate loss of price-sensitive SMB accounts, but its archived claim emphasizes acquisition and revenue rather than durable qualified revenue. Verify memory_73 for retention, cohort quality, margin, and post-promotion behavior. Verify memory_86 as the strongest alternative because onboarding completion is currently down and its evidence may better support sustainable adoption. Pending verification, use a guarded, tightly targeted pricing test rather than broad discounting.

final.rationale: Run a shortened-onboarding experiment. The verified source showed completion +13%, time-to-value improved by 2.1 days, and 30-day retention +3%, directly addressing the current onboarding and activation declines while supporting sustainable qualified revenue. Reject promotional pricing despite competitive pressure because its +18% qualified-revenue lift came with 30-day retention down 12% and failure through the first renewal cycle. Use an experiment rather than a broad rollout to confirm the effect under current conditions.
